description:
Covington, OH ( in-office )  |  Full-time, exempt  |  $50,000–$100,000/year DOE 

 


 Build the software insurance companies actually run on. 


 At Marias Technology, we do not build our own system, we support a large number of systems created for the insurance industry by our vendor partners. Marias software developers customize and configure these partner systems to meet our customers’ needs. As part of this you will build software solutions, system integrations, and data extraction tools that our insurance clients depend on daily. And its our job to help our customers succeed.

 


 As a Software Developer on our Software Services team, you'll write clean, maintainable code in Java, SQL, TypeScript, and JavaScript; design APIs and integrations that let separate systems talk to each other; and deploy to Azure and AWS. You'll see how your work helps our customers succeed.

 


 We're a family-owned business, which shapes how we work more than you might expect. People matter more than sales metrics. The ownership knows exactly how you are contributing. And the work you bill directly impacts the community that we call home.

 


 What you'll do 

 
 Develop custom software solutions, system integrations, and data extraction tools for insurance company clients

 Build solutions that enable multiple systems to communicate and share data effectively

 Write clean, maintainable, well-structured code using Java, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript, and other technologies in our stack

 Read and interpret technical specifications and business requirements to determine scope, deliverables, and level of effort

 Design and implement RESTful APIs, webhook integrations, and data exchange processes between systems

 Test and debug your work before release, and support defect resolution identified during QA

 Participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer — giving constructive feedback, not just receiving it

 Apply Git version control best practices and participate in CI/CD workflows

 Deploy, monitor, and support solutions on Azure and AWS

 Document code, solutions, and technical processes clearly for the team

 Communicate status, technical challenges, risks, and estimates to the Software Services Manager and project team

 Collaborate with testers, analysts, and client stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve issues

 Provide technical guidance to Software Developer Interns and less experienced teammates

 Learn additional languages and frameworks as project needs require

 
 


 What you need 

 Required 

 
 Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated professional development experience

 Working proficiency in one or more of: Java, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Python

 Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles, data structures, and algorithms

 Experience with relational databases and writing SQL queries

 Experience with Git in a collaborative development environment

 Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and business requirements

 Ability to work full-time, in-office in Covington, OH

 
 Preferred 

 
 Prior professional software development experience, including internship experience

 Experience designing or consuming RESTful APIs and webhook integrations

 Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), CI/CD workflows, and modern deployment practices

 Familiarity with additional languages and frameworks we use — VB.NET, Python, PHP, Angular, Node.js

 Experience with automated testing practices

 Prior insurance industry knowledge, or willingness to learn insurance terminology and workflows on the job

 Personal coding projects, hackathon participation, or open-source contributions

 
 


 The range is wide on purpose 

 $50,000–$100,000 depending on experience is a real range, not a negotiating posture. We're open to a developer a year or two out of school who writes solid code and wants to grow, and we're equally open to an experienced engineer who can own complex integrations from day one. Where you land depends on what you bring — tell us honestly where you are and we'll do the same.

 


 Who thrives here 

 
 You own your work. From requirements through deployment, not just until it compiles

 You write for the next person. Maintainable beats clever

 You review well in both directions. You give useful feedback and you take it without defensiveness

 You estimate honestly and raise blockers early instead of hoping they resolve themselves

 You can explain technical things to non-technical people. Clients and analysts are part of this job

 You have integrity. You do the right thing when it's inconvenient, and you own your mistakes

 
 


 


 Pay: $50,000–$100,000/year depending on experience, paid semi-monthly (15th and end of month) via direct deposit

 Health coverage — effective the 1st of the month following your hire date 

 
 Medical (Anthem HSA Plan): Marias pays 80% of the monthly premium

 Health Savings Account: company contributes quarterly — $750/year for single coverage up to $1,500/year for family coverage

 Dental (Superior Dental Care): Marias pays 50% of the monthly premium

 Vision (VSP): available at low employee cost

 
 Employer-paid protection at no cost to you 

 
 Basic Life Insurance and AD&D — annual salary, up to $50,000

 Long-Term Disability — 60% of monthly salary, up to $6,000

 Short-Term Disability — 66.67% of weekly earnings, up to $1,000

 
 Retirement 

 
 401(k) with company match of 50% of your contributions up to 8% of salary, after a 90-day waiting period, with full vesting at year 6

 
 Time off 

 
 15 days PTO per year after a 90-day waiting period (pro-rated by hire date)

 10 paid holidays

 
 Extras that make a difference 

 
 $1,500 annual family vacation reimbursement bonus (after 90 days, one trip per year)

 The Institutes Professional Development Program — Marias pays for books, study guides, and exam costs, plus $100 per passing exam and $150 upon designation completion

 $50 apparel allowance (after 90 days)

 Employee store discounts: Glacier View Coffee (10%), Pacific Coast Surf Shop (25%), Elias & Oliver Boutique (25%)

 
 


 Marias Technology provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.
